parameter_refs.name: vehicle_class

quote: It is unlawful for the driver of any vehicle: When crossing at grade any track or tracks of a railroad, to fail to completely cross the track or tracks without stopping due to insufficient: (1) Space for the vehicle on the opposite side of the railroad crossing; or (2) Undercarriage clearance of the vehicle. As used in this section, “completely cross” means to travel across a railroad track or tracks in such a manner that the trailing end of the vehicle is 15 feet or more past the nearest rail of the railroad track or tracks.

activation.condition: A driver of a vehicle crosses at grade a railroad track or tracks.

judgment_calls_needed.note: Causality requires original obstruction, contact, control and traffic-conflict review; no gap cutoff is invented.
Actual multi-track rail identity and trailing-end projection are retained; geometric interpretation requires review.

obligation.description: Do not fail to completely cross the track or tracks without stopping due to insufficient opposite-side space or undercarriage clearance.

timing.description: Completely cross means the actual trailing end is 15 feet or more past the nearest rail of the track or tracks; observe any intervening stop and its physical cause.
